# CELL FRACTIONS 

## Within class 
```{r}
cell_fractions <- read.csv("Data/Cibersort Data/Analysis Data/Cibersort_Arcsin_Estimated_Cell_Fractions_ED2WK6M_120_3-23-2026.csv")


cell_df <- cell_fractions %>%
  mutate(PID = as.character(PID)) %>%
  left_join(
    RRS_df_median_2wk %>%
      mutate(PID = as.character(PID)) %>%
      dplyr::select(PID, RRS_median_group),
    by = "PID") %>%
  filter(
    RRS_median_group %in% c("High_RRS", "Low_RRS"),
    Timepoint %in% c("ED","WK2","M6"))

cell_cols <- cell_df %>%
  dplyr::select(-X, -PID, -INVENTORY.CODE, -Timepoint, -Data, -RRS_median_group) %>%
  names()

cell_long <- cell_df %>%
  dplyr::select(PID, RRS_median_group, Timepoint, all_of(cell_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(cell_cols),
    names_to = "CellType",
    values_to = "Fraction")

cell_wide <- cell_long %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Timepoint,
    values_from = Fraction)

cell_delta <- cell_wide %>%
  mutate(
    delta_ED_WK2 = WK2 - ED,
    delta_WK2_M6 = M6 - WK2, 
    delta_ED_M6 = M6 - ED)

cell_interval_results <- purrr::map_dfr(
  seq_len(nrow(intervals)),
  function(i) {
    comp  <- intervals$Comparison[i]
    time1 <- intervals$time1[i]
    time2 <- intervals$time2[i]

    cell_wide %>%
      dplyr::group_by(RRS_median_group, CellType) %>%
      group_modify(~ run_paired_interval_test(.x, time1, time2)) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      mutate(
        Comparison = comp,
        .before = 1
      )
  }) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(RRS_median_group, Comparison) %>%
  mutate(FDR = p.adjust(`P Value`, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(RRS_median_group = factor(RRS_median_group, levels = c("High_RRS", "Low_RRS")))

cell_interval_results <- cell_interval_results %>%
  dplyr::select(Comparison, RRS_median_group, CellType, FDR, `P Value`, `Avg Δ (WK2 − ED)`, `Avg Δ (M6 − WK2)`,`Avg Δ (M6 − ED)`, `T Stat`, `SE`, `95% CI`, `Avg ED`, `Avg WK2`, `Avg M6` ) 

# EXPORT ------------------------------------------------------------
wb <- createWorkbook()

header_style <- createStyle(textDecoration = "bold", halign = "center")
body_style   <- createStyle(halign = "center")

add_sheet_with_data <- function(wb, sheet_name, data) {
  addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
  writeData(wb, sheet = sheet_name, data)

  addStyle(wb, sheet = sheet_name, header_style,
           rows = 1, cols = seq_len(ncol(data)), gridExpand = TRUE)

  if(nrow(data) > 0) {
    addStyle(wb, sheet = sheet_name, body_style,
             rows = 2:(nrow(data) + 1), cols = seq_len(ncol(data)), gridExpand = TRUE)
  }

  setColWidths(wb, sheet = sheet_name, cols = seq_len(ncol(data)), widths = "auto")
}

sheet_order <- expand_grid(
  RRS_median_group = c("High_RRS", "Low_RRS"),
  Comparison = c("ED_vs_WK2", "WK2_vs_M6", "ED_vs_M6"))


for(i in seq_len(nrow(sheet_order))) {

  group_i <- sheet_order$RRS_median_group[i]
  comp_i  <- sheet_order$Comparison[i]

  sheet_data <- cell_interval_results %>%
    filter(as.character(RRS_median_group) == group_i, Comparison == comp_i) %>%
    arrange(`P Value`)
  
  sheet_name <- paste(group_i, comp_i, sep = "_")
  add_sheet_with_data(wb, sheet_name, sheet_data)
}

saveWorkbook(wb, "2WK Analyses/Cell Proportions/Within Group Longitudinal Tests/EDWK2M6_cells_within_class_results.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)



cell_interval_results_export <- cell_interval_results %>%
  dplyr::rename(Interval = Comparison ,
                `RRS Group` = RRS_median_group, 
                `Cell Type` = CellType) %>%
    mutate(
  Interval = case_when(
    Interval == "ED_vs_WK2" ~ "ED vs WK2",
    Interval == "WK2_vs_M6" ~ "WK2 vs 6M",
    Interval == "ED_vs_M6" ~ "ED vs 6M",
    TRUE ~ as.character(Interval)
  ), 
    `RRS Group` = case_when(
    `RRS Group` == "High_RRS" ~ "High RRS",
    `RRS Group` == "Low_RRS" ~ "Low RRS",
    TRUE ~ as.character(`RRS Group`)
  ),
   Direction = case_when(
      Interval == "ED vs WK2" & `Avg Δ (WK2 − ED)` > 0 ~ "Higher at WK2",
      Interval == "ED vs WK2" & `Avg Δ (WK2 − ED)` < 0 ~ "Higher at ED",
      Interval == "WK2 vs 6M" & `Avg Δ (M6 − WK2)` > 0 ~ "Higher at 6M",
      Interval == "WK2 vs 6M" & `Avg Δ (M6 − WK2)` < 0 ~ "Higher at WK2",
      Interval == "ED vs 6M" & `Avg Δ (M6 − ED)` > 0 ~ "Higher at 6M",
      Interval == "ED vs 6M" & `Avg Δ (M6 − ED)` < 0 ~ "Higher at ED",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
     ` Cell Type` = recode(
      `Cell Type`,
      "Neutrophils" = "Neutrophils",
      "Monocytes" = "Monocytes",
      "Macrophages.M2" = "M2 Macrophages",
      "T.cells.CD4.memory.resting" = "Resting Memory\nCD4+ T cells",
      "T.cells.CD8" = "CD8+ T cells",
      "B.cells.naive" = "Naive B cells",
      "NK.cells.activated"= "Activated NK cells",
      "NK.cells.resting" = "Resting NK cells",
      "T.cells.regulatory..Tregs." = "Regulatory T cells", 
      "Plasma.cells" = "Plasma cells", 
      "B.cells.memory" = "Memory B cells", 
      "T.cells.CD4.naive" = "Naive CD4+ T cells", 
      "Dendritic.cells.activated" =" Activated Dendritic cells",
      "Mast.cells.resting" =' Resting Mast cells'
      )
  ) %>%
    mutate(Interval = factor(Interval, levels = c("ED vs WK2", "WK2 vs 6M", "ED vs 6M"))) %>%

  arrange(Interval, `RRS Group`, `P Value`)  %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), format_num))



write.csv(cell_interval_results_export, "2WK Analyses/Cell Proportions/Within Group Longitudinal Tests/EDWK2M6_cell_within_results_class.csv")
```

## Between class 
```{r}
cell_delta_results <- purrr::map_dfr(
  unique(cell_delta$CellType),
  function(ct) {

    df_ct <- cell_delta %>% filter(CellType == ct)

    bind_rows(
      run_delta_test(df_ct, "delta_ED_WK2") %>%
        mutate(Comparison = "ED_vs_WK2"),
      run_delta_test(df_ct, "delta_WK2_M6") %>%
        mutate(Comparison = "WK2_vs_M6"), 
      run_delta_test(df_ct, "delta_ED_M6") %>%
        mutate(Comparison = "ED_vs_M6")
    ) %>%
      mutate(CellType = ct, .before = 1)
  }
) %>%
  group_by(Comparison) %>%
  mutate(FDR = p.adjust(`P Value`, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(`P Value`)


cells_between_sheets <- list(
  ED_vs_WK2 = cell_delta_results %>%
    filter(Comparison == "ED_vs_WK2") %>%
    arrange(`P Value`),
  WK2_vs_M6 = cell_delta_results %>%
    filter(Comparison == "WK2_vs_M6") %>%
    arrange(`P Value`),
  ED_vs_M6 = cell_delta_results %>%
    filter(Comparison == "ED_vs_M6") %>%
    arrange(`P Value`))

wb <- createWorkbook()

header_style <- createStyle(textDecoration = "bold", halign = "center")
body_style   <- createStyle(halign = "center")

add_sheet_with_data <- function(wb, sheet_name, data) {
  addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)
  writeData(wb, sheet = sheet_name, data)

  addStyle(wb, sheet = sheet_name, header_style,
           rows = 1, cols = seq_len(ncol(data)), gridExpand = TRUE)

  if(nrow(data) > 0) {
    addStyle(wb, sheet = sheet_name, body_style,
             rows = 2:(nrow(data) + 1), cols = seq_len(ncol(data)), gridExpand = TRUE)
  }

  setColWidths(wb, sheet = sheet_name, cols = seq_len(ncol(data)), widths = "auto")
}

purrr::iwalk(
  cells_between_sheets,
  ~ add_sheet_with_data(wb, sheet_name = .y, data = .x))

saveWorkbook(wb, "2WK Analyses/Cell Proportions/Between Group Change Score Tests/EDWK2M6_cells_between_class_results.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)



```

## Figure 6e
```{r}
cells_plot <- c("Neutrophils", "Monocytes", "Macrophages.M2", "T.cells.CD4.memory.resting", "T.cells.CD8", "B.cells.naive", "NK.cells.activated",  "NK.cells.resting", "T.cells.regulatory..Tregs.",  "Plasma.cells",  "B.cells.memory",  "T.cells.CD4.naive")

plot_df_cells <- cell_long %>%
  filter(RRS_median_group %in% c("High_RRS", "Low_RRS"),
         Timepoint %in% c("ED", "WK2", "M6"),
         CellType %in% cells_plot) %>%
  mutate(
    Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = c("ED", "WK2", "M6")),
    RRS_median_group = factor(
      RRS_median_group,
      levels = c("Low_RRS", "High_RRS"),
      labels = c("Low RRS", "High RRS")),
    CellType = recode(
      CellType,
      "Neutrophils" = "Neutrophils",
      "Monocytes" = "Monocytes",
      "Macrophages.M2" = "M2 Macrophages",
      "T.cells.CD4.memory.resting" = "Resting Memory\nCD4+ T cells",
      "T.cells.CD8" = "CD8+ T cells",
      "B.cells.naive" = "Naive B cells",
      "NK.cells.activated"= "Activated NK cells",
      "NK.cells.resting" = "Resting NK cells",
      "T.cells.regulatory..Tregs." = "Regulatory T cells", 
      "Plasma.cells" = "Plasma cells", 
      "B.cells.memory" = "Memory B cells", 
      "T.cells.CD4.naive" = "Naive CD4+ T cells"),
    CellType = factor(CellType, 
                      levels = c("Neutrophils", "Monocytes", "M2 Macrophages", "Regulatory T cells",
                                 "Resting Memory\nCD4+ T cells", "Naive CD4+ T cells", "CD8+ T cells",
                                 "Activated NK cells", "Resting NK cells", "Naive B cells",  
                                 "Memory B cells",  "Plasma cells"))) %>%
  group_by(RRS_median_group, Timepoint, CellType) %>%
  summarise(mean_fraction = mean(Fraction, na.rm = TRUE),
            se = sd(Fraction, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(Fraction))),
            .groups = "drop")




cell_fraction_plot <- ggplot(plot_df_cells,aes(x = Timepoint, y = mean_fraction, 
                                               group = RRS_median_group, color = RRS_median_group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3.2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_fraction - se, ymax = mean_fraction + se),
                width = 0.08,linewidth = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ CellType, scales = "free_y", ncol = 6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Low RRS" = "firebrick4", "High RRS" = "cyan3")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Cell Fraction", color = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = function(x) {r <- range(x, na.rm = TRUE)
                     seq(r[1] + 0.06 * diff(r), r[2] - 0.06 * diff(r), length.out = 3)},
                     labels = function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey95", linewidth = 0.8),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "plain", size = 14, margin = margin(b = 2)),
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 16),
    axis.text.y.left = element_text(color = "black", size = 14, margin = margin(r = 1)),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "lines"), 
    panel.spacing.y = unit(0.3, "lines"), 
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0, "pt"),
    legend.margin = margin(t = -8),
    legend.box.margin = margin(t = -8),
    plot.margin = margin(t=15, b = 15))+
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linewidth = 1.8, size = 5)))

cell_long
```

## Figure 6e v2
```{r}
cells_plot <- c("Neutrophils", "Monocytes", "Macrophages.M2", "T.cells.CD4.memory.resting", "B.cells.naive","NK.cells.resting")

plot_df_cells <- cell_long %>%
  filter(RRS_median_group %in% c("High_RRS", "Low_RRS"),

  summarise(mean_fraction = mean(Fraction, na.rm = TRUE),

cell_fraction_plot <- ggplot(plot_df_cells,aes(x = time_days, y = mean_fraction,
```
